name: evilginx2
description: evilginx2 is an open-source adversary-in-the-middle (AiTM) attack framework based on the open-source nginx web server. evilginx2 can be used as a reverse proxy between victims and legitimate web services to intercept and capture credentials, authentication tokens, and session cookies.(Citation: Evilginx 2 July 2018)(Citation: Breakdev Evilginx 2.1 SEP 2018)(Citation: Sophos Evilginx MAR 2025)
